contract: docs/design-contract.md; editorial storefront and reusable garment/design personalizer; scoped local delivery, no payment processing

accessibility.evidence: Reviewed named navigation, form labels, image alternatives, pressed option states and visible keyboard focus. Tab from brand focused the bag with a 2px green outline. Key text contrasts calculated from rendered colors: muted/paper 4.63:1, ink/paper 15.65:1. Enlarged mobile header, sort selector and footer touch areas after inspection; reduced-motion CSS present. This is a scoped review, not a comprehensive WCAG certification.
